messages.content: I was billed after canceling.
I can help check that. Please share the cancellation date and the date of the charge so we can determine what happened.
My reset email never came.
Please check spam first, then confirm the email address on the account. If it still doesn't arrive, I can help with the next recovery step.
Can I change plans today?
Yes. Open Billing > Plan and choose the new plan. Before you confirm, you'll see when the price change takes effect.
The app froze during checkout.
I can help troubleshoot that. Tell me which device and browser you used and whether the payment appears in your account before trying again.
I need my invoice for March.
Open Billing > Payment history and select March to download the invoice. If it isn't listed, tell me the account email and I'll help locate it.
My delivery is late.
I can help check the shipment. Please send the order number and I'll walk you through the latest delivery status and available options.
This discount code says invalid.
Let's check the code conditions. Send the code and the items you're purchasing, and I'll help identify why it isn't applying.
I don't know this transaction.
I can help investigate it. Please share the transaction date and amount, but don't send your complete payment-card number.
How do I change my account email?
Go to Settings > Account > Change email. You'll need to verify the new address before the update is complete.
I bought the wrong subscription.
I can help review your options. Tell me the plan you purchased and the one you wanted, and we'll determine the cleanest change.
